features.title: From footage to a policy that checks itself
features.intro: Bot18 is a one-day build on Gemini 4 Argon. Argon reads robot footage, builds a sim, writes its own reward from the video, practises and compiles what works into cheap routines. Everything is sim only, and this page shows the evidence for each step.

items.name: Brain switch
items.text: Results from Argon and from Claude, which stood in for it, stay apart. A switch shows one brain or both side by side, never merged into one number.

items.name: Data tracks
items.text: Each data track, such as REASSEMBLE robot recordings or LIBERO sim demos, goes through the same loop. Picking one switches the whole page to that track's clips, steps and numbers.

items.name: Evidence cards
items.text: Every tile, clip, result and skill tag opens a card with the long read. A footage card plays all the camera views of one moment side by side, in sync.

items.name: Compiled routines
items.text: Argon compiles what worked into a routine that needs no brain calls. On 24 unseen starts it seated the part 8 times, against 5 for Claude's routine, in under a quarter of the sim time.
